<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915493_theRebbe_561" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915493_theRebbe_561__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions why the Torah, being eternal, records Yaakov's refinement in a top-down manner when current service is bottom-up, and explains that it provides power for both bottom-up refinement and top-down refinement through Torah, especially its inner dimension.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And it must be understood:</t>
    <t s="2">Behold, the Torah is eternal,</t>
    <t s="3">and all the stories and instructions in the Torah are eternal instructions,</t>
    <t s="4">and since the service now is in a manner of from below to above,</t>
    <t s="5">why is it written in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="6">and at length,</t>
    <t s="7">the story of "And Yaakov sent messengers... to Esav,"</t>
    <t s="8">whose content is a refinement from above to below.</t>
    <t s="9">And even more so, it requires explanation that it is recounted in the Torah</t>
    <t s="10">(which is eternal)</t>
    <t s="11">also the order of Yaakov's refinement,</t>
    <t s="12">the refinement of the three upper sefiros</t>
    <t s="13">(Lavan)</t>
    <t s="14">before the refinement of the seven lower sefiros</t>
    <t s="15">(Esav).</t>
    <t s="16">And one may say the explanation:</t>
    <t s="17">That this which by our forefather Yaakov the refinement was in a manner of from above to below is</t>
    <t s="18">(as all the deeds of the forefathers</t>
    <t s="19">are)</t>
    <t s="20">a sign and a giving of power to the children</t>
    <t s="21">for this very service.</t>
    <t s="22">And this means:</t>
    <t s="23">That in addition to this, that the refinement of Yaakov in a manner of from above to below is a giving of power for the refinement in a manner of from below to above</t>
    <t s="24">(the primary refinement of now),</t>
    <t s="25">it is a giving of power also for the matter of the refinement in a manner of from above to below of the children,</t>
    <t s="26">the refinement that is through Torah.</t>
    <t s="27">And within Torah itself — the refinement that is through the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="28">for the primary matter of refinement in a manner of from above to below is in the inner dimension of Torah.</t>
    <t s="29">And as was explained previously</t>
    <t s="30">(in the discourse "Pidah B'Shalom")</t>
    <t s="31">at length,</t>
    <t s="32">that the refinement through the revealed aspect of Torah,</t>
    <t s="33">since it is clothed in the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil in order to refine clarifications,</t>
    <t s="34">is analogous to the refinement in a manner of from below to above,</t>
    <t s="35">in a garment</t>
    <t s="36">(in a manner of war),</t>
    <t s="37">in contrast to the refinement through the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="38">the Tree of Life</t>
    <t s="39">(which is not clothed in Good and Evil),</t>
    <t s="40">which is not in a manner of garment,</t>
    <t s="41">from above to below.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that while in general the revealed Torah relates to refinement and the inner Torah is above refinement, in particular each contains both aspects, as seen in the Alter Rebbe's Tanya and in the Written Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, the above distinction between the revealed aspect of Torah and the inner dimension of Torah is in general,</t>
    <t s="2">but in particular,</t>
    <t s="3">each of them contains both matters</t>
    <t s="4">(for the Torah was stated in general and in particular).</t>
    <t s="5">And the matter is,</t>
    <t s="6">as the Alter Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="7">the master of the redemption of Yud-Tes Kislev,</t>
    <t s="8">[for this Shabbat, from it are blessed all the days that follow it,</t>
    <t s="9">including the day of redemption, Yud-Tes Kislev]</t>
    <t s="10">wrote in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="11">that the study of the inner dimension of Torah is "a lofty and exalted commandment... and brings to a whole heart,"</t>
    <t s="12">and brings to a whole heart,"</t>
    <t s="13">meaning,</t>
    <t s="14">that in the study of the inner dimension of Torah there are two matters.</t>
    <t s="15">The first,</t>
    <t s="16">that it brings to a whole heart,</t>
    <t s="17">for this matter in the inner dimension of Torah pertains to the refinement of the emotions,</t>
    <t s="18">and the second,</t>
    <t s="19">that the study and knowledge of the inner dimension of Torah</t>
    <t s="20">(in its own right)</t>
    <t s="21">is "a lofty and exalted commandment" — a matter of the inner dimension of Torah that is above refinements.</t>
    <t s="22">And likewise, conversely,</t>
    <t s="23">that also in the revealed aspect of Torah there are matters that are above the matter of refinements.</t>
    <t s="24">Like the study in a manner of "expound and receive reward"</t>
    <t s="25">that does not pertain to action,</t>
    <t s="26">which is</t>
    <t s="27">(within the revealed aspect of Torah itself)</t>
    <t s="28">above the matter of refinements.</t>
    <t s="29">And this matter</t>
    <t s="30">(that also in the revealed aspect of Torah there is a matter above refinements)</t>
    <t s="31">is more emphasized in the Written Torah.</t>
    <t s="32">For the study of the Written Torah with understanding and comprehension,</t>
    <t s="33">and especially the study of its instructions</t>
    <t s="34">(both in the laws of the Written Torah and in its stories)</t>
    <t s="35">regarding action,</t>
    <t s="36">pertains to the matter of refinements,</t>
    <t s="37">in contrast to the study of the stories of the Written Torah as they are in themselves,</t>
    <t s="38">and all the more so the reading of the Written Torah that is above comprehension entirely</t>
    <t s="39">(for even one who does not understand even the meaning of the words fulfills the mitzvah of Torah study),</t>
    <t s="40">is like the inner dimension of Torah that is above refinements.</t>
    <t s="41">And as explained in Likkutei Torah</t>
    <t s="42">that the inner dimension of Torah is included in the third</t>
    <t s="43">in Scripture.</t>
    <t s="44">And likewise, conversely,</t>
    <t s="45">that also in the book of Tanya,</t>
    <t s="46">the Written Torah of Chassidus</t>
    <t s="47">(the inner dimension of Torah),</t>
    <t s="48">there is also a matter that pertains to refinements,</t>
    <t s="49">as the Alter Rebbe wrote in the introduction and also in the gate</t>
    <t s="50">(of the Tanya)</t>
    <t s="51">that it is founded on the verse</t>
    <t s="52">"For this matter is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, to do it," to explain well how it is very near, etc.,</t>
    <t s="53">meaning that the intention and purpose of the book of Tanya is to explain how to do it.</t>
    <t s="54">But this matter</t>
    <t s="55">[that both in the revealed aspect of Torah and in the inner dimension of Torah there are both matters]</t>
    <t s="56">is in particular,</t>
    <t s="57">but in general,</t>
    <t s="58">the revealed aspect of Torah pertains to refinements</t>
    <t s="59">(and in a manner of garment),</t>
    <t s="60">and the inner dimension of Torah is the Tree of Life that is above the matter of refinements,</t>
    <t s="61">and the refinement that is accomplished through the study of the inner dimension of Torah is not in a manner of garment.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as Yaakov's refinement was from above to below, beginning with the upper sefiros, so too through the study of Chassidus, refinement occurs in the intellect itself, including that which is above the emotions, even now.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that just as the refinement of Yaakov,</t>
    <t s="3">being in a manner of from above to below</t>
    <t s="4">(through the revelation of supernal light),</t>
    <t s="5">was also in the order of from above to below,</t>
    <t s="6">that he refined the three upper sefiros before he refined the emotions,</t>
    <t s="7">so too is it in the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="8">that through the study of Chassidus with understanding and comprehension,</t>
    <t s="9">there is accomplished a refinement of the intellect and also of the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="10">including also the intellect that is above connection to the emotions.</t>
    <t s="11">For the refinement through the revealed aspect of Torah is</t>
    <t s="12">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="13">in the emotions and in the intellects that are connected to the emotions,</t>
    <t s="14">in contrast, through the study of the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="15">since it is "a lofty and exalted commandment" in its own right</t>
    <t s="16">(above this that it "brings to a whole heart"),</t>
    <t s="17">the refinement is accomplished also in the essence of the intellect.</t>
    <t s="18">And although the conquest of Kini, Kenizi, and Kadmoni</t>
    <t s="19">(the essence of the intellect that is above the emotions)</t>
    <t s="20">will be only in the future</t>
    <t s="21">(after the completion of the refinement of the emotions and the intellects connected to the emotions),</t>
    <t s="22">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="23">a semblance of this is also now through the study of the inner dimension of Torah.</t>
    <t s="24">And this is what is recounted in the Torah about the manner of Yaakov's refinement</t>
    <t s="25">(through the revelation of supernal light)</t>
    <t s="26">and also the order of the refinement</t>
    <t s="27">(that he began with the refinement of the three upper sefiros),</t>
    <t s="28">that these two matters are</t>
    <t s="29">(like all matters in the Torah)</t>
    <t s="30">eternal instructions also now,</t>
    <t s="31">as above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
